new_sources.title: SK hynix to Supply Industry's First HBM3 DRAM to NVIDIA
new_sources.excerpt: SK hynix announced that it began mass production of HBM3. NVIDIA has recently completed its performance evaluation of SK hynix’s HBM3 samples. SK hynix will provide HBM3 for NVIDIA systems expected to ship starting in the third quarter of this year.
new_sources.locator: News Highlights; opening body paragraphs on production, NVIDIA evaluation, and future system supply

new_sources.title: Samsung Develops Industry-First 36GB HBM3E 12H DRAM
new_sources.excerpt: Samsung has begun sampling its HBM3E 12H to customers and mass production is slated for the first half of this year.

new_sources.title: 3Q 2024 Pre-Earnings Guidance
new_sources.excerpt: the start of the HBM3E business to a major customer was delayed relative to our expectations.
new_sources.locator: Explanatory note to the 3Q24 provisional results, final Memory/HBM paragraph

new_sources.title: Samsung Electronics 2024 Q4 Earnings Call
new_sources.excerpt: In the fourth quarter, we expanded our HBM3E supply to multiple GPU providers and data center clients.

new_sources.title: Micron Innovates From the Data Center to the Edge With NVIDIA
new_sources.excerpt: Micron is the world’s first and only memory company shipping both HBM3E and SOCAMM products.

new_sources.title: SK hynix Ships World's First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples to Customers
new_sources.excerpt: World's First 12-Layer HBM4 Samples ... to start the certification process ... aims to complete preparations for mass production.

new_sources.title: SK hynix Announces 2Q26 Financial Results
new_sources.excerpt: The company began mass shipments of HBM4 in the second quarter

new_sources.title: Samsung Electronics 2025 Q3 Earnings Call
new_sources.excerpt: we have shipped samples to all customers

new_sources.title: Samsung Electronics 2025 Q4 Earnings Call
new_sources.excerpt: entered the final phase of qualifications; already commenced production, and shipments will start in February.
new_sources.locator: PDF page 24, HBM business Q&A answer

new_sources.title: Samsung Ships Industry-First Commercial HBM4 With Ultimate Performance for AI Computing
new_sources.excerpt: Samsung Electronics, a global leader in advanced memory technology, today announced that it has begun mass production of its industry-leading HBM4 and has shipped commercial products to customers.
new_sources.locator: first body paragraph immediately after deck/subheads

new_sources.title: Micron Ships HBM4 to Key Customers to Power Next-Gen AI Platforms
new_sources.excerpt: Micron Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: MU), today announced the shipment of HBM4 36GB 12-high samples to multiple key customers. Micron plans to ramp HBM4 in calendar year 2026, aligned to the ramp of customers’ next-generation AI platforms.

new_sources.title: Micron in High-Volume Production of HBM4 Designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin
new_sources.excerpt: Micron Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: MU), has begun volume shipment of its HBM4 36GB 12H in the first quarter of calendar year 2026 and is designed for NVIDIA Vera Rubin.
new_sources.locator: first body paragraph after News highlights

new_sources.title: SK hynix Ships Samples of 12-Layer Next-Gen HBM4E
new_sources.excerpt: SK hynix Inc. (or “the company”, www.skhynix.com) announced today that it has shipped samples of HBM4E, a next-generation DRAM for AI, to major customers.

new_sources.title: Samsung Electronics Begins Shipment of Industry-First HBM4E Samples
new_sources.excerpt: Samsung Electronics has begun shipping 12-layer HBM4E samples to major global customers. Samsung plans to begin mass production of HBM4E aligned with customer schedules.
new_sources.locator: first body paragraph and mass-production plan paragraph

new_sources.title: Micron Technology Reports Results for the Third Quarter of Fiscal 2026
new_sources.excerpt: Development of HBM4E, built on 1-gamma DRAM technology, is well underway, with volume production expected in calendar 2027.

new_sources.title: Azure previews ND H100 v5 virtual machine series
new_sources.excerpt: ND H100 v5 is available for preview and will become a standard offering.
new_sources.locator: Azure’s most powerful and scalable AI virtual machine, final paragraph

new_sources.title: Scale generative AI with new Azure AI infrastructure advancements and availability
new_sources.excerpt: Today marks the general availability of our Azure ND H100 v5 Virtual Machine (VM) series, featuring the latest NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs and NVIDIA Quantum-2 InfiniBand networking.
new_sources.locator: General availability of ND H100 v5 VMs, opening paragraph

new_sources.title: Announcing Cloud TPU v5e and A3 GPUs
new_sources.excerpt: We’re also delighted to announce that our A3 VMs, based on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, delivered as a GPU Supercomputer, will be generally available next month to power your large-scale AI models.

new_sources.title: Accelerating AI inference with Google Cloud TPUs and GPUs
new_sources.excerpt: In August 2023 we announced the general availability of A3 VMs.
new_sources.locator: A3 VMs: Strong results for AI inference, first paragraph

new_sources.title: New Amazon EC2 P5 Instances Powered by NVIDIA H100
new_sources.excerpt: Today, we are announcing the general availability of Amazon EC2 P5 instances.
new_sources.locator: Introducing EC2 P5 Instances, opening paragraph

new_sources.title: Amazon EC2 P5e instances available through EC2 Capacity Blocks
new_sources.excerpt: P5e instances are now available through EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML.

new_sources.title: Amazon EC2 P5en instances generally available
new_sources.excerpt: AWS announces the general availability of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) P5en instances, powered by NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs.
new_sources.locator: opening paragraph and final region paragraph

new_sources.title: General availability of OCI Compute powered by NVIDIA H100
new_sources.excerpt: Today, Oracle is announcing general availability of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) bare metal Compute instances powered by NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPUs and NVIDIA networking.

new_sources.title: The world's largest AI supercomputer in the cloud
new_sources.excerpt: Orderable now: OCI Compute bare metal with NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs (Generally available later this year)

new_sources.title: OCI Supercluster with NVIDIA H200 now generally available
new_sources.excerpt: We’re excited to announce the general availability of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Supercluster with NVIDIA H200 Tensor Core GPUs.

new_sources.title: Building Meta's GenAI Infrastructure
new_sources.excerpt: Today, we’re sharing details on two versions of our 24,576-GPU data center scale cluster at Meta. These clusters support our current and next generation AI models, including Llama 3, our most ambitious large language model yet.

new_sources.title: Scale AI transformation with cloud infrastructure
new_sources.excerpt: We are beginning to bring these systems online in preview, co-validating and co-optimizing with NIVIDIA and other AI leaders. Azure ND GB200 v6 will be a new AI optimized Virtual Machines series and combines the NVIDIA GB200 NVL 72 rack-scale design with state-of-the-art Quantum InfiniBand networking.

new_sources.title: Microsoft and NVIDIA accelerate AI development and performance
new_sources.excerpt: Today, Microsoft is excited to announce the general availability of Azure ND GB200 V6 virtual machine (VM) series accelerated by NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 and NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand networking.
new_sources.locator: ND GB200 V6 general availability paragraph

new_sources.title: Introducing A4 VMs powered by NVIDIA B200 GPU
new_sources.excerpt: Today, we’re excited to bring the highly-anticipated NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs to Google Cloud with the preview of A4 VMs, powered by NVIDIA HGX B200.

new_sources.title: Google Cloud goes to NVIDIA GTC
new_sources.excerpt: We’re are pleased to announce that A4 VMs are generally available, and that A4X VMs are in preview with general availability coming soon.

new_sources.title: Amazon EC2 P6-B200 instances generally available
new_sources.excerpt: Today, AWS announces the general availability of Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) P6-B200 instances, accelerated by NVIDIA B200 GPUs.
new_sources.locator: opening paragraph; Capacity Blocks availability paragraph

new_sources.title: AWS AI infrastructure with NVIDIA Blackwell
new_sources.excerpt: we’re excited to announce general availability of P6e-GB200 UltraServers, accelerated by NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Superchips.

new_sources.title: OCI Blackwell compute order and planned availability
new_sources.excerpt: Orderable now: OCI Compute bare metal with NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs (Generally available H1 2025). OCI Compute bare metal with NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 (Generally available H1 2025).

new_sources.title: Meta's infrastructure evolution and the advent of AI
new_sources.excerpt: Our GB200 rack, Catalina, with AALC systems connected into single pod.

new_sources.title: Amazon 2022 Form 10-K
new_sources.excerpt: Cash capital expenditures were $59.2 billion, and $58.3 billion in 2021 and 2022, which primarily reflect investments in technology infrastructure (the majority of which is to support AWS business growth) and in additional capacity to support our fulfillment network.
new_sources.locator: Item 7, Liquidity and Capital Resources, cash capital expenditures

new_sources.title: Oracle Announces Fiscal 2023 Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Full Year Financial Results
new_sources.excerpt: Capital expenditures (8,695). Oracle signed contracts to purchase more than $2 billion of capacity in Oracle’s Gen2 Cloud.
new_sources.locator: FY cash-flow table; executive quote paragraph on capacity contracts

new_sources.title: Meta Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2023 Results
new_sources.excerpt: We anticipate our full-year 2024 capital expenditures will be in the range of $30-37 billion. We expect our ambitious long-term AI research and product development efforts will require growing infrastructure investments beyond this year.
new_sources.locator: 2024 outlook, capital expenditures and infrastructure paragraph

new_sources.title: NVIDIA Q3 FY2025 CFO Commentary
new_sources.excerpt: We completed a successful mask change for Blackwell, our next Data Center architecture, that improved production yields. Blackwell production shipments are scheduled to begin in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025 and will continue to ramp into fiscal 2026. Both Hopper and Blackwell systems have certain supply constraints, and the demand for Blackwell is expected to exceed supply for several quarters in fiscal 2026.
new_sources.locator: Data Center section, production and supply-constraint paragraph

records.observed_fact: NVIDIA disclosed a Blackwell mask change and system supply constraints.
records.possible_transmission_path: GPU architecture and production schedule to platform availability and upstream memory demand timing.
records.possible_decision_relevance: Monitor constraint migration and request internal supply-risk verification.
records.why_outside_h1: The disclosure concerns supply/production constraints rather than H1 signal-quality measurement.
records.activation_condition: Activate only in the approved H2 supply/production module.

records.observed_fact: Samsung disclosed that HBM3E business with a major customer was delayed.
records.possible_transmission_path: Competitor commercialization timing to customer selection and relative market position.
records.possible_decision_relevance: Monitor competitor qualification and commercial timing without inferring share.
records.why_outside_h1: H1 retains the delay as counterevidence but does not perform competitive-position analysis.
records.activation_condition: Activate after a Competition module contract and source-scope rules are approved.

records.observed_fact: Oracle disclosed company-level cloud capacity purchase contracts.
records.possible_transmission_path: Cloud capacity contracting to infrastructure readiness and platform deployment.
records.possible_decision_relevance: Identify which dependency evidence would be needed before treating investment as operational capacity.
records.why_outside_h1: The source does not map the capacity contract to a frozen named platform.
records.activation_condition: Activate after an ecosystem-dependency module defines admissible entity links.

records.observed_fact: Micron disclosed HBM4E development and a future volume-production expectation.
records.possible_transmission_path: Product development to supply readiness and later commercialization.
records.possible_decision_relevance: Monitor production readiness while preserving development-stage uncertainty.
records.why_outside_h1: The H1 Track records the disclosure as HOLD context; production economics and constraints belong to H2.
records.activation_condition: Activate when H2 is approved and the event is independently reviewed.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: A single H1 track could compare every demand-adjacent disclosure as one signal ladder.
records.action_performed: Preserved the frozen two-strata registry and collected product commercialization separately from platform realization.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: Pilot records showed that supplier production and CSP availability answer different observability questions.
records.judgment_or_change: Kept H1-P and H1-C as separate strata and prohibited pooled interpretation.
records.why_it_mattered: It prevents a broad investment disclosure from being treated as a product commercialization event.
records.overclaim_boundary: No H1 comparative result or predictive superiority is claimed.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: Manual copying was sufficient for a 24-Track corpus.
records.action_performed: Implemented deterministic import of immutable Pilot artifacts, archive generation, SHA-256 verification, link checks, and replay manifests.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: The full collection required consistent provenance across reused and newly archived official sources.
records.judgment_or_change: Moved deterministic bookkeeping into the CorpusBuilder while leaving semantic admission unapproved.
records.why_it_mattered: Source and event lineage can be replayed without turning AI output into approval.
records.overclaim_boundary: The builder validates contracts; it does not establish empirical signal quality.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: Volume or mass production could stand in for commercial acceptance.
records.action_performed: Reclassified production records as PRODUCTION_STAGE_CONTEXT and added revised records without deleting Pilot HOLD history.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: Official releases often disclosed production before actual customer supply or used future shipment wording.
records.judgment_or_change: Production now remains supply-readiness context unless direct current customer shipment evidence establishes O1.
records.why_it_mattered: It blocks stage inflation in semiconductor commercialization analysis.
records.overclaim_boundary: Production context does not reveal customer demand volume, price, share, or allocation.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: A corpus of official announcements might adequately represent commercialization paths.
records.action_performed: Required both supporting and contradictory primary-source searches for every Track and separated explicit negative evidence from public non-observation.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: Samsung explicitly disclosed an HBM3E customer-business delay, while most Tracks had no public adverse disclosure.
records.judgment_or_change: Recorded one as explicit counterevidence and the others as disclosure-limited NOT_OBSERVED_PUBLICLY.
records.why_it_mattered: Silence no longer becomes an implicit success observation.
records.overclaim_boundary: NOT_OBSERVED_PUBLICLY does not mean no delay or failure occurred.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: Publication dates could be used directly as historical event dates.
records.action_performed: Stored event_at, published_at, available_at, accessed_at, origin group, revision, and content hash separately.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: A Google Cloud retrospective GA statement conflicted with the earlier forward-looking timing and could have been backdated.
records.judgment_or_change: Kept the retrospective candidate on HOLD and preserved its later availability date.
records.why_it_mattered: Earlier historical states cannot gain knowledge from later descriptions.
records.overclaim_boundary: Exact historical GA date remains unresolved until a contemporaneous source is found.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: CSP CAPEX and named GPU platform availability could be joined as one demand fact.
records.action_performed: Recorded CAPEX at company scope and platform stages at SKU scope, then made the missing bridge explicit.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: Official filings did not allocate CAPEX to a named H100, H200, B200, or GB200 offer.
records.judgment_or_change: Prohibited CAPEX-to-SKU allocation and platform-to-HBM-supplier inference.
records.why_it_mattered: The corpus can inform monitoring and internal verification requests without inventing volume or supplier share.
records.overclaim_boundary: No platform utilization, exact memory demand, or supplier identity is inferred.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: A collector's proposed classification could enter the empirical dataset directly.
records.action_performed: Separated collector candidates, deterministic validation, HOLD state, and future human Gate 6 review.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: Development-only and installed-rack wording could otherwise pass as sample or operational realization.
records.judgment_or_change: Added minimal lexical guards for explicit sample wording and installed-operational evidence.
records.why_it_mattered: AI-assisted extraction cannot bypass the evidence-governance boundary.
records.overclaim_boundary: Lexical validation does not replace human semantic approval.

records.initial_problem_or_assumption: Completing collection meant the corpus was ready for H1 calculation.
records.action_performed: Produced 24-Track coverage and missingness summaries while setting gate6_frozen=false and empirical_h1_calculated=false.
records.evidence_or_failure_encountered: Several recent HBM4/HBM4E and Blackwell Tracks remain right-censored or HOLD-only.
records.judgment_or_change: Stopped at the human Gate 6 readiness boundary.
records.why_it_mattered: The project preserves research truth before lead, realization, ranking, or verdict calculations.
records.overclaim_boundary: No H1 metric, ranking, causal conclusion, or verdict exists.
